'''July 2000 Minneapolis tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Minneapolis, MN in July 2000. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d984">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-08-minneapolis-mn-7-9-00d984/ minneapolis-mn-7-9-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 8 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-08-minneapolis-mn-7-9-00d984/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' July 2000
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
